name: gsc-mcp-remote
description: Ask Claude real questions about your Google Search Console data, across every property in your account. 33 SEO analysis tools.
long_description: A Google Search Console MCP server that answers SEO questions instead of returning API rows: quick win keywords, traffic drops diagnosed by cause, content decay, keyword cannibalisation, CTR benchmarks, multi-site dashboards, and a full image-search suite with an on-page image audit. Every property-scoped tool takes an optional site_url, and list_properties shows what your account can access, so one install covers all your properties instead of just one. Free and open source, Apache-2.0. Installed this way it runs entirely on your machine; the same server can also be deployed as a remote MCP server with per-user Google sign-in, so a team connects by URL. A fork of Suganthan Mohanadasan's GSC MCP.

site_url.title: Default Search Console property (optional)
site_url.description: Used when a tool is called without site_url, e.g. sc-domain:yoursite.com or https://www.yoursite.com/. Leave blank to work across all your properties and name one per request; ask Claude to list your properties to see them.

access_level.title: Access level
access_level.description: readonly (recommended) or full. Full adds sitemap and URL submission tools.

secrets_file.title: Google OAuth client secrets JSON
secrets_file.description: Path to your OAuth client secrets file. Needed until built in Google sign in ships; see the README quick start.
